cycles.notes: Highest-impact discovery: Lazarski has Apollo Global Management AND Boeing AND General Dynamics AND Anduril as 2024 Cornerstone clients, and Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-MA, sitting SASC member — Lazarski's former committee) has a documented, written, two-axis attack on both Apollo (Steward Health bankruptcy letter) and the entire defense-contractor lobbyist class Lazarski exemplifies (her Pentagon-corporate-influence platform). This is the cleanest say-vs-pay extension and the recommended promotion to a parallel data-detective finding (alongside C-004's Brownstein/Apollo cluster). Second-most important structural finding: three of the five top tier lobbyists work at the same firm (Cornerstone Government Affairs — Richards and Lazarski; Young is at her own Tarplin Downs & Young; Teague is at Alpine; O'Neill is at Colton Street/Harbinger). Cornerstone deserves a firm-level Spotlight follow-up as the second-tier analog to Brownstein.
